trigger: User confirms uniform map appearance; mounted source becomes transparent when moving and must remain opaque.

contracts.finding: One native driver reads movement and lerps alpha for registered active frames.
Movement-start, movement-stop, gliding and impulse events merge deferred registrations into the active table.
RemoveFrameInternal removes the specified frame from both active and deferred registration tables.
AddDeferredFrame is event-deferred registration, not a C_Timer callback.
RemoveFrame restores maxAlpha only for an active registration, then removes active and deferred registrations. A solely deferred frame does not have alpha restored automatically.

world_map_registration.retail: WorldMap.lua342-389: OnShow adds deferred fade(.5,1,.5) with mapFade/not-IsMouseOver predicate; OnHide removes frame.
world_map_registration.classic: Mists-loaded Cata/WorldMap.lua320-344 does not register native movement fading, but the identical service is loaded.

recommended_change: After native source OnShow during preparation, remove only that source frame from PlayerMovementFrameFader, keeping preparation alpha zero.
After adoption or embedded source re-show, remove only that source frame again and set its own alpha to1 outside preparation.
Use table function call PlayerMovementFrameFader.RemoveFrame(world), without a colon.
Allow normal full-map native OnShow to register its own deferred fade again; preserve mapFade CVar and all unrelated service frames.
No global function replacement, fader private-table access, new movement listeners, timers or per-frame alpha enforcement is necessary for this native service.
performance_scope: Removes source frame's fade iteration and alpha writes while mounted. The shared native driver itself still exists and unrelated registered frames remain unchanged.
limits: Source-level lifecycle proof only; the new opacity implementation still requires native movement/full-map acceptance.
